1.

Let us sing, Sing of Jesus’ grace; Old and young, Praise His counsel of love, Praise His precious grace!

2.

Heaven and earth Are full of His glory; Yet He has become Poor for mankind’s sake, The children of dust and clay.

3.

Willingly He took Sickness and need upon Him, Patiently endured All that may press me Here on my wilderness path.

4.

The judgment He bore, Tasted also the death of the cross, To redeem us From our sin and need, Yes, from an eternal death.

5.

All to win Himself a chosen bride, Who might find Grace and favour before God Only in His own robe.

6.

Let us sing Eternally of this Friend! Heart and tongue Praise His love still Here and in heaven!
